name: capoff_floor
aim: Split hypothesis (a) CAP-as-energy-source vs (d) propagator/grid numerics: rerun effmass_sigma1 with EM_CAP=0 (two-sided CAP OFF), WP on, full energy decomposition, write_every=5, 200 steps. If the >0 ΔE rise VANISHES with CAP off => (a) confirmed; if it survives => (a) refuted and the newly-logged components (external/nonlocal/ion/eigenvalues/nvxc) expose the culprit.
method: inq-study mass fork; 40x40x80 cell, dx=0.333, dt=0.04, ETRS, LDA, gamma; GS reused from shared_gs/slab_n52_L40x40x80_dx0p333; WP injected (wp_idx=35, m_eff=2.10) but CAP eta set to 0 via EM_CAP=0; v_bg background ON (EM_BG=1); full ObservableSelection energy decomposition ON.

advisor_verdict.probe_reading: CAP-off (eta=0), WP+v_bg on, full decomp, 200 steps/t=8 a.u.: E_total(t)-E_total(0_RT) MAX=0.0 eV, final=-0.0147 eV -- never crosses above 0, conserved to propagator floor. +221 eV vs E_GS is a flat WP-injection offset, not a drift. Big component motions (H +23, ext -30, kin +3.5 eV) cancel: 8 components sum to E_total to 1e-13 Ha every step. Sigma eps_i drifts +24 eV while E_total flat (band != total, benign). CAVEAT: t=8 a.u. window may pre-date WP reaching the CAP (z=+/-32.5, launch z=-16.5).

ledger.evidence: Removing ONLY the CAP removes the >0 rise (MAX=0.0 eV); with phase-0 eta-tracking this isolates the CAP as the ledger's non-Hermitian energy term. Not yet CONFIRMED at this early window.
v_bg was ON yet E_total conserved to -0.015 eV; the isolating +v_bg-only control still owed.
Component sum == E_total to 1e-13 Ha; CAP-off conserves vs RT0; E_GS gap is a flat offset. Rise is CAP-gated, not reference-gated.
Same ETRS/dx/dt/cutoff/WP conserve E_total to -0.015 eV with CAP off.
kin+H+xc+ext+nl+ion+ion_kin+exx == E_total to 1e-13 Ha every step; drifts cancel exactly; no KS double-counting.
